verdict.rationale: Shopify POS has a first-party API reference for POS UI extensions on shopify.dev. It documents APIs such as shopify.storage, shopify.toast and shopify.action.presentModal(), and notes that extensions can query the GraphQL Admin API via fetch(). Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in the browser, so only the API-reference half of the story is supported. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer or playground, runnable in-docs examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
